g.aria-label: The Second-Order Memory Wall: Full Hessian H ∈ ℝ^10⁶ × 10⁶
10¹² entries = 4 TB in float32: cannot store or invert
Newton–CG & curvature probes only need the Hessian–vector product H v ∈ ℝⁿ:
Pearlmutter's Trick (1994): Forward-Over-Reverse HVP in O(n) Time & Memory
H v = J_∇ℓ(x) v = d/dε ∇ℓ(x + ε v) at ε = 0
Seed x with Dual(xⱼ, vⱼ) and run reverse-mode grad(ℓ) once (~4–6× forward cost)!
Carries dual tangents alongside backward closures without recording a second tape
